question: What is the value of (180 div 15-12+13)/(4 { of ) 3+1}?
solution:
Solution:

We have to follow the BODMAS rule

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1990743799104f72f2abd6652abaa7fa2655f318b14e04461d14c46970986fe3.png] 

Calculation:

⇒ (180 div 15-12+13)/(4 { of ) 3+1}

⇒ (12 - 12 + 13)/(12 + 1)

⇒ 13/13 = 1

The answer is 1.
